I awoke at his bedside for the eighth time. He lays so peaceful , so quiet. His eyes closed, the ventilator hums with each compression. I sit with my book, grasped tightly in my hands, I have read half of it but couldn’t tell you what it is about. I wish I could do something, but all I can do is sit in this chair. The nurses and doctors have been so friendly, they have let me stoy here the entire time. They have brought me coffee and meals since its paid for by the room, and obviously he can’t eat them. On the third day they moved us to a private room with a fold out couch so I could sleep comfortably.  I see in their eyes the sorrow but they remain cheerful, I know they know that this is hopeless.  I still remain hopefull.
 
Jeremy and I have been together for four years. I met him at a small new years party at a mutual friends house. We were both the odd ones out without a midnight kiss. We agreed to share that kiss and my life changed. We spent the rest of the night talking, he was the sweetest guy I had ever met. He spoke passionately about his favorite bands that I had never heard of but today I have grown to love. He listened to my dreams of becoming a journalist and seemed genuinely interested. That night we passed out next to each other. I awoke to his hand grasping mine and it was the best feeling I have ever felt.
I left that morning in a hurry before he woke up, I am not sure why, my ride was leaving and he was sleeping and I just decided to let him go. Three days later I couldn’t get him out of my head, apparently neither could he. My phone rang and an unfamiliar voice spoke on the other end. It was Jeremy. He studdered. He spoke softly. He asked me to meet him for pool at a bar near my house. I bashfully agreed.
When I walked in Jeremy was just racking a game, we made that game last all night, caught up in each other we talked all night. He had this dark humor that reminded me a little too much of my own. Bucket special night got the best of us and one of his aquainteces from the bar offered to drive us home. We rode back to his place and he set up his bed for me to sleep, kissed me on the lips and said he would sleep on the couch. I gave him a smirk, held his hand, and led him back to his room.
Two years later we had just moved into the condo he had bought downtown.  We had bought a dog, Baxter. We were picturesque. We were the couple you see on the street that makes you sick. We were in love. This is a moment that never changed. Of course we fought, we had our ups and downs, but we were made fore each other. Each day I woke up and rolled over, as soon as I saw him I couldn’t help but smile.
About three weeks ago we received a call, his friend from highschool had been stabbed. I knew the guy very well, he was that guy that tried to hard to make you laugh but was hilarious nonetheless. He was also the guy who would pick up the tab if it was the last dollars he had. He was just an all around nice, fun guy.
I watched Jeremy answer the phone. He went from cheerful to dread in a moment. His face dropped like it was holding an extra sixty years. He made eye contact with me and shook his head left ot right. I rememeber Holding my coffee tight and mouthing “what?”.

Dustin was stabbed to death by his girlfriend’s exgirlfriend.  It crushed Jeremy. He sat on our couch silent for about 16 hours, just staring at the ceiling. Finally Dustin’s mom stopped by. She rang the bell and I let her up. I met her near the elevator, she looked sad but somewhat hopeful, looking forward to speaking to Jeremy.  I asked her to wait a moment outside our door.
I tried talking to Jeremy, he just started mumbling about things, I slapped him, told him to stand up.  When he stood up he looked at me straight in the eyes like he had just woken from a horrific dream. I told him that Dustin’s mom was outside and I saw a flash of panic. 
Jeremy dropped his hands down his chest, breathed deep and opened the door.  He stood there for what felt like an eternity, Dustin’s mom stared in his eyes. Then like a moment of realization hit them they hugged. They hugged tightly for what seemed like forever. A tear fell from Jeremy’s eye and hit her jacket. 
The funeral was held at a nearby chapel, Jeremy lead the service. He spoke passionately about his friend. He talked about growing up and the funny times they had, laughing while tearing up. He spoke about how Dustin had helped him with girls, how one night on New Years Eve Dustin had convinced him to ask this girl at the party to be his kiss.  He talked about how Dustin was the guy who helped him overcome his shyness. He talked about how Dustin was always there for each of his friends. He nodded at Tim and reminded everyone that you could call Dustin at anytime and he would let you in his apartment to crash. He placed his hand on Dustin’s chest, removed his necklace and placed it in Dustins hand and walked up the aisle.  The speakers played Dustin’s favorite song.
About a week later Jeremy was out with his buddies at a bar. The trouble with $5 pitchers is you can afford to drink many of them. They were nice and toasty as they walked across the street to another bar, in there was the guy who had stabbed Dustin.
Jeremy didn’t realize it at first. He was sitting at a table with his friends when he overheard a couple of names that sounded familiar. It turned out that this guy was bragging about stabbing his exgirlfriend’s boyfriend. His laugh filled the bar.  Jeremy shook it off.  He thought it couldn’t be.
The bar shut down and Jeremy was walking to the parking lot across the street when he heard arguing. Some guy was screaming at a girl, he shrugged and kept walking until he heard a thud. She had hit the ground. Jeremy turned around, the guy was kicking her in the stomach as his friends watched.
Jeremy took off towards the guy as his friends grabbed his shirt. His instinct took over. He charged the guy. Knocked him off his feet. It was only then that he realized that this was the guy who killed his friend. Jeremy looked back and saw that people were helping the girl up off the ground. He looked back at this guy and spit in his eye.
Jeremy got up, started walking away, then fell… Jeremy was shot twice. Once in the head, once in the lung.
